title: Export an immutable score revision input
description: Export a pinned revision. Adapter availability comes from the deployed capability matrix; unsupported formats fail. Loss is allowed only when the request explicitly opts in.

common__Id.description: Opaque stable external identifier. A displayed measure number, staff number, or event ordinal is not an identifier. External IDs are not automatically legal SFS aliases: use the returned alias/reference map and TextIdentifier for fragment-local names.

common__RevisionId.description: Immutable score revision identifier; never the mutable alias latest.
